en: The Opinion Bits each began to give off light once more and started exchanging auras.{w}{p}Before long, the Opinion Bits all turned toward Zaalhaut at once.{w}
"..........{w}...We have reached the conclusion that we are unable to answer."{w}{p}"We will set this topic aside. Please enlighten us as to the correct answer."{w}
note: Echoes row 1662 ("unable to understand" there, "unable to answer" here). Second page reused verbatim in row 1676.

en: "It's hair."{w}
note: Answer to the riddle in row 1666 (the longer it grows, the closer it gets to the ground).

en: "...I see. Understood.{w}Now then, your elimination..."{w}
"What is it... that has endless faces?"{w}
note: Riddle; Zaalhaut's answer in row 1677 is "a name".

en: Just as before, the Opinion Bits began exchanging auras.{w}

"These things have a habit of needing to know exactly where a conversation starts and where it ends."{w}{p}"So the longer I keep them stumped, the more time I can buy.{w}...Now go, quickly, while you have the chance."{w}{p}"Don't worry about me.{w}I haven't lived such a feeble life that I need brats worrying about me."{w}{p}"Leave this to me, and hurry to the Coronation Hall."{w}
note: "Coronation Chamber" for [JP] (new term). [JP] -> "brats" (Zaalhaut's gruff voice, [JP]). Accuracy: "Coronation Chamber" -> "Coronation Hall" to match the same scene (rows 1643/1656/1657) for the same term (taikan no ma). Editorial: "insisting on recognizing" was clumsy. "the more I keep them puzzling" was unidiomatic.

en: The question-and-answer session between Zaalhaut and the Opinion Bits goes on and on.{w}
"We will set this topic aside. Please enlighten us as to the correct answer."{w}
note: Identical to the second page of row 1669; kept word for word.

en: "A name."{w}
"That which is truly equal, that which walks on without ever looking back, that which is carved by a great sword and a small sword...{w}Do you know what it is?"{w}
note: Riddle for "time" (clock hands = great/small sword). Phrases are quoted back in rows 1688 and 1692, kept matching.

en: "...That would be light."{w}
"Hm?{w}What's this, you've decided to answer after all?{w}Too bad, though. The answer is 'time.'"{w}
"No. No such thing exists."{w}
"It is light."{w}
"Surely the flow of time is the same for each and every thing in existence."{w}
note: Editorial: Trailing "surely" made the argument limp; reordered.

en: "No, it is light.{w}That which falls equally upon all things -- that is light."{w}
"...I'm telling you, it's time."{w}
"There is no such thing as time.{w}It is light."{w}
".........."{w}{p}"...Then what about the clue 'that which walks on without ever looking back'?"{w}

"It is light."{w}{p}"Light -- that is to say, the great Elnoa-Malem -- is the one who will abolish such foolish pacts of the past as the Phase Shift, and bring stability to the future of the Real Axis."{w}
note: [JP] -> "the great Elnoa-Malem" ([JP] rendered without Lord/Lady: gender unknown). [JP] = "Phase Shift" (as in chap slice_007 / wmap slice_19). [JP] -> "the True Axis": coined, meaning unclear (real + pivot + foundation) - flag. Accuracy: jitsusuuki rendered "the Real Axis" as already established in chap row 1360 (Numbra Narv: "not the Narv of the Real Axis").

en: "El... noa...? Malem, you say?"{w}
"We have answered your question. This conversation is over.{w}Now then, your elimination..."{w}
"W-wait!{w}Then what about 'carved by a great sword and a small sword'!?"{w}{p}"That's supposed to mean the hands of a clock! You can't explain that, can you!?"{w}
note: Editorial: Stutter capitalisation as in the rest of the corpus (W-well, R-right).

en: "Why, light, naturally."{w}{p}"The lesser sin of you all defying us, the greater sin of failing to fulfill your duty of bringing forth the Eld..."{w}{p}"Those two swords, the lesser sin and the greater, wound the heart of the great Elnoa-Malem."{w}
note: [JP] = "the Eld" (wmap slice_19). [JP] read as "you (mortals) all", the Bit addressing Zaalhaut's kind generally.

en: "Wh... what are... you... saying..."{w}

"We have answered your question. This conversation is over.{w}Now then, let us carry out your elimination."{w}{p}"Those who set foot in the Sanctum of Genesis are fated to be judged by the Opinion of Light and the Opinion Bits."{w}
note: [JP] -> "Sanctum of Creation" (new term). [JP] -> "the Opinion of Light" (new term). First sentence kept identical to row 1691. Accuracy: same term as rows 1641-1654 of this scene ("Sanctum of Genesis"); corpus still also has "Holy Genesis Sphere" (rows 1574-1585) -- orchestrator to settle.

en: "The Opinion of Light...!?"{w}

note: Naru = god of time per wmap slice_16. [JP] -> "the power over time"; [JP] -> "divine protection"; [JP] -> "a god of light". [JP] -> "Shebe" (new name, nature unknown: a place or people that fell).

en: "...You who know too much.{w}Be burned by the holy light, and vanish."{w}
"Ha, just try it, you heartless lackeys!"{w}

"It is futile.{w}Even if one or two of us should fall, more of us will appear, however many it takes."{w}{p}"You never had a chance to begin with.{w}If you step aside, we will at least let you pass on without suffering. What will you do?"{w}
note: [JP] read as "if you clear the way" (stop blocking the Bits from pursuing the party). Editorial: "appear again in any number" was unidiomatic; ikura demo kept as "however many it takes".

en:
"No chance, you say?{w}Heh, you really do look down on me.
...This is a waste of time. Come at me, all of you at once."{w}
(Those kids will perform the rite of re-coronation and come back alive.{w}Buying them the time for that is all I need.){w}
note: Inner thought. [JP] -> "those kids" (Zaalhaut calls the party [JP] in row 1674). [JP] -> "rite of re-coronation" (new term).

en: "I am Zaalhaut, the child the wicked mage Zanu left behind.{w}
note: Opening quote left unclosed as in source; row 1704 re-shows this text in {0E}..{0F}. [JP] -> "Zanu" (new name). [JP] = child left behind by a dead parent.

en:
{0E}"I am Zaalhaut, the child the wicked mage Zanu left behind.{0F}
The cursed child that lust and a spirit's tears brought into this world!"{w}
note: Highlighted part matches row 1703 word for word.

en: "Let's see how long mere servants of a god can stand against this unblessed power of mine!"{w}
note: Source has a typo ([JP] for [JP]).

en: Op. Bit Voice
note: Name box, 17 chars (slightly over ~16). Fallback if too wide: "Op. Bit Voice". Several Bits speak in row 1707; Zaalhaut is down and only hears them. Accuracy: name box cut to 13 chars (<=16) using the translator's fallback.
Exchange between several Opinion Bits. [JP] -> "Ryug" (wmap slice_20). [JP] -> "this one" (no pronoun for Zaalhaut). 2[JP] literally "only two"; "possibilities" added for the noun.

en: The Opinion Bits left.{w}

"So... I couldn't win after all...{w}In the end... all I can do...
is dance in the palm of a god's hand...?"{w}{p}"I can't hear anymore. My eyes are going dim.{w}I wonder if those kids pulled it off..."{w}
"The land where I was born... my precious place...{w}This... cursed body of mine...{w}the only... thing that ever... ac... cepted it..."{w}{p}"Mo... th... er...{w}I'm sor... ..."{w}
note: Dying line; Zaalhaut switches from [JP] to [JP] (no English equivalent). Order of the broken fragments kept across the {w}s. [JP] -> "Mother"; [JP]… -> "I'm sor..." (gomen). [JP] read as the land accepting the cursed body.

en: Spirits gathered around Zaalhaut.{w}Lifting up the body, they carried it all the way to the exit.{w}
note: Editorial: Tense mismatch inside the row (present then past).

en: Strange Being
note: [JP] = the unnamed figure before it introduces itself as Spectoria (row 1715).

en: "So you have come this far after all."{w}
"I am Spectoria. Executor of the Divine Realm."{w}
note: Spectoria / Divine Realm as in wmap slice_19. [JP] -> "Executor" (wmap uses Executor for [JP] Branon).

en: You feel an overwhelming presence from the one called Spectoria, unlike anything you have felt before.{w}There is nowhere for you to run.{w}
note: No pronoun for Spectoria (gender not in glossary).

en: "Ordinarily, the likes of you would be nothing more than a trifling matter."{w}{p}"But you have gone too far.{w}Anything more would go against the divine will."{w}{p}"You will now receive your punishment. Prepare yourselves."{w}

"As one would expect of those who made it all the way here."{w}{p}"It cannot be helped.{w}This time, and this time only, I shall withdraw."{w}{p}"But do not forget that you are always in the palm of our hand..."{w}
note: Editorial: "worthy of having made it" was awkward; sasuga ... dake no koto wa aru.

en: Spectoria vanished into the light.{w}{p}Having defeated the Qualia, you stood in the center of the room and raised all the Ranks you had obtained toward the sky.{w}They then turned into the shining [Sun's Light Rank].{w}
note: [JP] -> "Qualia" (new term; guardians of the Sanctum, see row 1643). [JP] -> "Ranks", [JP] -> "Radiant Rank of the Sun" (new key item name, must match ITEM_PRIZ when that CSV is translated). [JP] -> [ ]. Editorial: Misplaced modifier ("the sky in the center of the room"). Rank terms untouched.

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Sun's Light Rank.{w}
note: Key-item format as chap slice_001.

en:
Fixed monster encounter handler
Flee: Yes, Treasure: Yes, Rematch: No, Friendly: Yes{w}
note: Developer debug text (encounter-type label); circle/cross marks rendered Yes/No in ASCII.

en:
Random monster encounter handler
Flee: Yes, Treasure: No, Rematch: Yes, Friendly: Yes{w}
note: Developer debug text.

en:
Event monster encounter handler
Flee: No, Treasure: No, Rematch: Yes, Friendly: No{w}
note: Developer debug text.

en:
Abi monster encounter handler
Flee: Yes, Treasure: No, Rematch: Yes, Friendly: No{w}
note: Developer debug text. [JP] = Abi (glossary).

en:
Magical Party encounter handler
Flee: No, Treasure: No, Rematch: Yes, Friendly: No{w}
note: Developer debug text.

en:
Martial Arts Tournament encounter handler
Flee: No, Treasure: No, Rematch: Yes, Friendly: No{w}
note: Developer debug text.

en: An unfamiliar adventurer appeared before you.{w}

note: Runtime insert only; nothing to translate.
Runtime insert only; nothing to translate.

en: There is a giant doll.{w}{p}When the doll spots you, it breaks into a big smile, as if it had found a new toy, and slowly reaches out its hands toward you.{w}{p}If a game of dolls is about to begin, the dolls will be you.{w}
note: Editorial: "playing the dolls" could be misread as playing WITH dolls; punchline tightened.

en: You picked up an item.{w}
note: Used in 30 places.

en: You see that 'Night' has appeared ahead of you.{w}Before long, the 'Night' takes human form and overwhelms everything around it with its sheer presence.{w}
Is that gentlemanly bearing a sign of how sure it is of itself?{w}The one who reigns at the summit of the Kin of Night unhurriedly invites you to a ball of death.{w}
note: [JP] -> "the kin of night" (patterned on "kin of darkness", chap slice_008 / wmap slice_20). No pronoun for the figure.

en: A strange sight is unfolding before your eyes.{w}{p}Darkness and darkness, cancelling each other out, are shrinking again and again.{w}{p}The darkness on your side gradually weakens and begins to be swallowed by new darkness seeping out.{w}
You stand face to face with one who has crossed over from another world.{w}Can you protect this world?{w}

You have come upon a dreamlike revel.{w}{p}Beautifully shining wings light up the surroundings like a full moon.{w}Insects of every kind are drunk on this revel of light, perhaps rejoicing at the appearance of their lord, who is wrapped in phosphorescent light.{w}{p}But there is just one unfortunate thing.{w}It seems no place has been set for you in this dreamlike scene.{w}
note: Editorial: Dangling modifier: "wrapped in phosphorescent light" read as describing the insects.

en: Even when you try to look, you cannot look away.{w}Even when you try to flee, you cannot fight.{w}Even when you want to die, you cannot survive.{w}{p}That is our Brain Through.{w}
note: Deliberately paradoxical/garbled verse, kept as is. [JP] -> "Brain Through" (new name; boss/encounter name, likely a pun). [JP] -> "our" (speaker unknown).

en: Suddenly, thunderclouds gather all around.{w}Each time lightning flashes, the shadow of some unknown beast is cast upon the sky.{w}
You witness the appearance of a fearsome monster.{w}

A strange sensation of space twisting.{w}Something that must never appear seems to have crossed the line and appeared.{w}{p}Will your bodies, too, be taken over like those of the victims before you?{w}
Azabas
note: New name (romanized).

en:
"What, you lot were wandering around a place like this?{w}Look at the power that's taken root in my body!"{w}{p}"I'm a Demon Duke now!
Nobody's ever going to give me lip again.{w}...Not even that bastard Fendel!!"{w}{p}"Come, scorching winds of destruction! Come to me!"{w}{p}"Let's teach them all that I'm the one who rules everything!
The Wastelands, the New Lands, the Dark Realm, the Divine Realm --
we'll teach every last one of them!!"{w}
note: [JP] -> "Demon Archduke" (new term; also used by the Ryug in SCD16). [JP] -> "Fendel" (new name). [JP] "Wastelands" (wmap: declared a wasteland), [JP] "New Lands" (new term), [JP] "Dark Realm", [JP] "Divine Realm" as in wmap. [JP]: Azabas rallies himself/the winds; rendered "let's". Accuracy: daimakou = "Demon Duke(s)" as established in chap rows 1561/1566/1572 (the Ryug quest); there are many of them, and MON_TEXT has Azabas envying Fendel's road to becoming one -> "a Demon Duke".

en: "Damn iiiiit!{w}Why am I losiiiiing!?!"{w}{p}"I...!{w}was supposed to have gotten... power no one could beat...!{w}Wasn't I...!?"{w}{p}"It's still... not enough...?"{w}
note: Editorial: "power that loses to no one" was unidiomatic.

en:
A scorching tornado swallowed Azabas from the feet up.
It was so fierce that you shut your eyes without thinking.{w}
When you next came to your senses, there was nothing there.{w}
Scrape, scrape. The sound of something being dragged draws gradually closer.{w}
note: Editorial: Onomatopoeia wedged mid-sentence read awkwardly; moved to the front as in the source.

en: A bizarre form was there, impossible to tell whether dragon or fish.{w}{p}It gave a shudder and let out a hair-raising roar.{w}It was the signal that mealtime had come.{w}
CLICK, CLACK, GO SOME CRISP, BRISK FOOTSTEPS.{w}IN TIME WITH THEM, A LOUD, HAUGHTY LAUGH RINGS OUT.{w}
note: Source is all-kana with spaced dakuten (retro 8-bit text parody, continued in slice_022 rows 1749-1752). Rendered in ALL CAPS as the English equivalent of old-console text; slice_022 should match. [JP] = loud/haughty laugh. Accuracy: takawarai = loud, haughty laughter, not high-pitched.

en: WHAT HAS APPEARED IS ONE ONCE HAILED AS A GOD OF WAR.{w}{p}FLUTTERING BOTH HANDS, IT DRAWS NEAR WITH A GENIAL SMILE.{w}{p}AND WHAT IT REAPS AS IT SMILES... IS LIVES.{w}
note: Master Drake (MONSTER3 epithet 'god of war'). Source is all-kana retro Wizardry pastiche (like 1748/1752); rendered in normal case -- ALL CAPS would be an option if the slice_021 row 1748 does the same. Editorial: Retro all-kana block 1748-1752 unified in ALL CAPS (old computer-RPG message style). Tense set to present ("has appeared", "draws") to match the present-tense source verbs and row 1748.

en: RAGING FIGURE
note: Unidentified-monster style name (Wizardry 'strange figure' convention), not a proper name. Editorial: Retro all-kana block 1748-1752 unified in ALL CAPS.

en:
"NOW THEN, YOU FRAIL THINGS.
ARE YOU PREPARED?"{w}
note: Editorial: Retro all-kana block 1748-1752 unified in ALL CAPS.

en: YOU PICKED UP AN ITEM.{w}
note: Kana-only retro variant of row 1731 (kanji version); same English. Editorial: Retro all-kana block 1748-1752 unified in ALL CAPS (row 1731, the kanji version, stays in normal case).

en:
With a thudding tread that shook the ground,
a fat man came walking along.{w}
He seemed to be trying to perform some sort of ritual, but his bulging belly kept getting in the way.{w}
note: Don Magus (MONSTER3 epithet 'big-underpants magic').

en: The man noticed you watching.{w}Perhaps thinking you were mocking his portly body, he came charging at you, face beet red.{w}
Portly Man
"Hey! Who do you think I am!?"{w}
?Lady Doctor
note: Female doctor (MON_TEXT 276; Norden Orc entry, epithet 'Where shall I treat?'). '?' prefix kept as in other unidentified names.

en: "Next, please."{w}
Addressed out of nowhere, you were taken aback.{w}But pinned by her gaze, which allowed no argument, you somehow got the impression that you were the ones in the wrong.{w}
"So, what seems to be the trouble today?"{w}
At her prompting, you answered questions about your health. The doctor nodded languidly, writing up a chart with flowing strokes of her pen.{w}

"...All right, that's enough.
Now, bare your bottom. Get down on all fours.{w}I'm going to prescribe you a nice, big, heaping dose."{w}
note: Innuendo kept at full strength; per MON_TEXT her treatment is an injection with a huge syringe.

en: A woman appeared with a great many arrows nocked to a single bow.{w}She flitted lightly about the area.{w}Letting her beautiful hair play in the wind, she spoke.{w}
Bow Saint Polyte
note: Glossary spelling.

en:
"Morning dew is sweet nectar. Birdsong is the gospel.
The deep forest is the cradle of life.{w}And I am the Holy Polyte."{w}
note: 'Holy Polyte' matches the item name (seinaru Polyte no yumi) and rows 1768/1777.

en: Shooting Moon
note: Monster name (MONSTER2/MON_TEXT 231); this one is Jenas, Polyte's rival in the play 'Periatif'.

en: "Don't go calling yourself holy, it's embarrassing!"{w}
"Good day to you, Jenas."{w}
note: Polyte: posh, ladylike (watakushi / -desu wa).

en:
"Come on,
let's play out the rest of Periatif!"{w}
note: Periatif = the play about Polyte and Jenas's rivalry (MON_TEXT 227/231): i.e. resume their duel.

en: "...I'm not in the mood for that."{w}
"Why the hell not?"{w}
"Because I dislike you, naturally."{w}

"Well, it's not like I'm chasing after you
because I like it either!"{w}

"And what is that, with your bottom hanging out for all to see?
My, how vulgar."{w}

"You're one to talk,
using a bow like that! That's not real archery!"{w}
note: jado = heretical/improper way; refers to her firing many arrows at once.

en:
"You don't understand at all, do you, Jenas."{w}{p}"That's where you're supposed to say,
'As expected of the Holy Polyte!'"{w}
Jenas
note: New name. Female: uses atashi, Polyte calls her anata (kanji for a woman) and 'doe'.

en: "Shut the hell up!"{w}
Jenas turned to you with an irritated look, pleading her case.{w}

"...Hey, you get it, right?{w}Half the reason I want to kill her
is that personality! She makes no damn sense!!"{w}
note: 'Her' = Polyte (female established in row 1764).

en:
"I have never once asked you to understand me.
(Snap!~)"{w}
note: pishari = curt, slamming retort; the note symbol rendered as '~' (ASCII only).

en: "Aaaargh... You're so damn annoyiiing...!{w}Hey, let's kill her already!!"{w}
note: Jenas to the party: 'let's' -- she invites you to fight Polyte with her. Editorial: Jenas speaks in contractions everywhere else.

en: "How d'you like this, huh!?"{w}
"Thud, and down I go~{w}...or so I'd jest! Tee-hee..."{w}{p}"The Holy Polyte...!!"{w}
note: batankyu = cutesy 'keel over'. Final fragment is a cry that breaks off; 1786 is written to stand alone too.

en: "It will take more than this to bring me down!{w}I shall surely appear again! Appear in splendor!"{w}
note: Editorial: "go down from something like this" was clumsy for Polyte's posh voice.

en: "Shut that mouth of yours!{w}Seriously, you want me to kill you!?"{w}

"Jenas, you've improved.{w}{p}I'm off to hunt Demon Dukes,
so do mind things here while I'm away."{w}
note: daimakou -> 'Archdemon' (no prior rendering in the corpus; MON_TEXT says Polyte hunts them in the wasteland). Accuracy: daimakou-gari -> "Demon Dukes" as established in chap rows 1561/1566/1572 (and row 1742).

en: "Huh!? Don't just go deciding that on your own..."{w}

"Honestly, that Taizarti,
swallowing up so many of my arrows.{w}I must get them back as soon as possible."{w}{p}"Well then, good day!{w}...My little doe with the cute bottom~"{w}
note: Taizarti spelling from 'Taizarti Lamp' (chap slice_001). Per MON_TEXT 312 Polyte's arrows are stuck in Taizarti's head; no pronoun used (gender unknown).

en: "Eek!?"{w}

Polyte gave Jenas's rear a single stroke,
then ran off laughing.{w}
The Shooting Moon called Jenas stood quivering with rage she had nowhere to vent.{w}Her bottom was quivering too.{w}
Spiderwebs clung to your bodies.{w}The more you brushed them off, the more the threads tangled around you.{w}
It seems you noticed something was wrong a little too late.{w}{p}Before you knew it, you had been dragged into the nest of a siren in the shape of a spider.{w}
note: youjo -> 'enchantress' (a bewitching monster-woman). Accuracy: youjo -> "siren" so the name box ?bi-youjo (row 1798) fits 16 chars as "?Fair Siren" while rows 1796/1797/1801 still match it.

en: Suddenly, you were wrapped in the scent of some flower.{w}Ah, so this is no mere siren.{w}One cloaked in the scent of flowers... a FAIR siren!!{w}
note: bi-youjo (coined self-flattering word) -> 'fair enchantress', same word as the name box and row 1801. Accuracy: youjo / bi-youjo -> "siren" / "fair siren" to match the 16-char name box in row 1798. Editorial: The first-person "I see" broke the second-person narration (flagged by accuracy); the realization (naruhodo) is kept.

en: ?Fair Siren
note: 17 chars, one over the ~16 guideline; '?Fair Siren' is a shorter fallback. Accuracy: was 17 chars (>16); "?Fair Siren" (translator's fallback); rows 1796/1797/1801 changed to match.

en: "Rolfaaaaan!!"{w}
note: Taranti's battle cry (also her MONSTER3 epithet). Meaning unknown; romanized.

en: Taranti
note: New name (spider woman; tarantula pun).

en: "Hegyah!?"{w}{p}"Th... that's so mean...{w}Roughing up a fair siren like me...{w}...Waaaah!!"{w}
note: Accuracy: bi-youjo -> "fair siren" to match the name box in row 1798. Editorial: Stutter capitalisation as in the rest of the corpus.

en: Taranti ran off with a sort of skipping gait.{w}
note: Editorial: "moving with something like a skip" was awkward.

en: Shaking heaven and earth, a grotesque, many-armed giant appeared.{w}It looked down at you and, amused by who knows what, rained down laughter like a thunderclap.{w}{p}But the next instant, the many-armed giant brought down a fist brimming with murderous intent.{w}
note: Hecatoncheir (not named in the text). 'nani ga tanoshii no ka' = for whatever reason it finds this fun; rendered as 'amused by who knows what'.

en: An unfamiliar knight of the Kin of Darkness appeared.{w}On a closer look she was a woman, and her dignified face showed iron resolve.{w}{p}Strength of heart becomes power.{w}From the Demon God Lance pointed at you, you sensed a blade of will honed to a terrifying edge.{w}
note: yami no kenzoku -> 'Dark Kin' (corpus is split: Dark Kin 5, Kin of Darkness 4, kin of darkness 4). Accuracy: en already uses the glossary form "Kin of Darkness" (glossary entry for yami no kenzoku); the "Dark Kin" remark above is superseded.

en: "My mother was betrayed by the gods and fell into darkness.{w}Even the small happiness she found after her fall had no future -- those of the New Lands stole her tomorrow."{w}{p}"And by the fate of all who side with darkness, my mother strayed from the Path of Souls and was swallowed up by the Abyss, that prison of souls."{w}
note: kami -> 'the gods' (number not marked). shinsouchi -> 'the New Lands' (new term). Speaker box is ??? (Sephiriege before she names herself).

en: Sephiriege
note: New name. Full Japanese box is 'Ankoku-metsu General Sephiriege'; the title is cut from the name box for length and is given in full in row 1807. Former name Sephirine (MON_TEXT 280).

en: "I am Sephiriege, Demon General of Dark Oblivion."{w}{p}"To save my mother's soul, and to bring an end to the injustice of the gods, I received a new name and power from Rogera."{w}{p}"The Demon God Lance will soon set out for the Abyss."{w}{p}"Should anyone stand in its way, whoever they may be...{w}even those who were once my brethren, I cannot spare them."{w}
note: anmetsu -> 'Oblivion' following Rogera's title in chap slice_008 / wmap slice_16. The lance line refers to herself through her weapon; kept. Accuracy: anmetsu = "Dark Oblivion", the exact word in Rogera's established title ("god of Dark Oblivion", chap row 595 / wmap row 1227); Sephiriege takes her name from Rogera in this very row.

en:
"Well, this is a surprise.
Though it has yet to fully settle in me, you've overcome power on par with a Divine Shadow?"{w}{p}"Perhaps we will meet again somewhere.{w}Heh heh heh..."{w}
note: shin'ei -> 'Divine Shadow' (wmap slice_01). 'it' = her newly granted power.

en: You saw a strange shadow ahead.{w}It seemed human-shaped, but its head was clearly wrong, writhing grotesquely.{w}{p}Soon the details of what had been shadow became clear.{w}You realized that where a human head should be, something else had been put in its place.{w}{p}How did you realize it?{w}Because the figure was closing in on you to attack.{w}
